size_basis: inline 254 nm reactor tube + control box at the 0.04 kW lamp class (A-M-428) (X-FARM sec3)
cad_stl_scope: build solid, metres (X-PAR-04 envelope registry; the rebuild fills the node box 400 x 350 x 750 flush)

machine.type: optional UV-C 254 nm loop sanitizer between the biofilter and the growbeds (A-M-428; AQUA_BYPASS normally engaged): SS304 cabinet 400 x 350 x 750 with the reactor train on the centreline - SS304 tube OD 90 x 280 (wall 2 mm study), quartz sleeve OD 60 x 260, and the 0.04 kW lamp as its envelope rod (purchased, plan rule 6)
machine.a_mach: the purchased lamp is named with the rating from the node (254 nm, 0.04 kW lamp class, A-M-428) and drawn as its envelope; the cabinet is the guard and the base anchors are drawn
machine.modes: normal = bypassed; food-safety mode = inline (A-M-427); contamination response = inline (node design) - the duty sheet carries the wetted-time caveat
machine.material: SS304 reactor tube with a quartz UV sleeve, PP loop fittings, EPDM gasket class

N1.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4)

N2.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4)

N3.note: drain flush at the envelope bottom; the 50 datum is the schedule placeholder at the base

N4.note: atmospheric open-bore tube stub flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); the schedule datum z 800 predates the build height 750 - drawn flush at the envelope top (hold, W12)

nozzle_idiom: atmospheric open-bore tube stubs flush at the envelope faces (duty section 4: DN15, no flange class, atmospheric tube or hose); N1 in on -Y at z 160, N2 out on +Y at z 600; N3 drain flush at the envelope bottom; N4 vent flush at the envelope top (schedule z 800 predates the 750 box - stale datum, hold W12); no flange drawn (W4 110 % rule); the schedule rating column (Class 150) carried verbatim as text
